Offline placement shortlist analysis. Download the one file for your machine:

| Your machine | File |
| --- | --- |
| Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 and later) | `nankiv_*_aarch64.dmg` |
| Mac with an Intel processor | `nankiv_*_x64.dmg` |
| Windows 10 or 11 | `nankiv_*_x64-setup.exe` |
| Windows, for IT deployment | `nankiv_*_x64_en-US.msi` |

Not sure which Mac you have? Apple menu → *About This Mac*.

These builds are not code signed yet, so the first launch takes one extra step:
on macOS right-click the app and choose *Open*; on Windows choose *More info* →
*Run anyway*. Once only.
